contracts.invariant: Assigned objects occur once each; bin sizes sum to the assigned total.
Every checkpoint totals eleven; the final maximum is three and minimum two.
No occupancy exceeds its stock; selected items remain distinct physical objects.
Each drawn segment joins two objects of one fiber; total segments equal the pair count.
Prefixes are canonical remainders; equal prefixes delimit a nonempty ordered block.
All displayed repunits have their computed remainders; the positive difference is divisible by six.
Both images have four elements; shared residues encode the stated square-sum relation.
Displayed sums are checked from selected indices; deleting the common part preserves equality.
Every integer has a unique odd core and successive nodes differ by a factor two.
Ten disjoint pairs and one singleton cover all twenty-one values.
The four midpoint cells have side one-half; displayed points retain their true geometric coordinates.
Coordinates are fractional multiples; intervals have width one-fifth and distinct endpoint ownership.
Every displayed label equals its strict predecessor recurrence; arrows respect index order.
Degree equals the number of incident neighbors; the two extreme labels never coexist.
Each unordered vertex pair has one color; the selected triangle has three equal-color edges.
Each of the first eighteen rows has one distinct pair-color certificate; row nineteen repeats it.
At depth q the full tree has two to q leaves, each with one distinct transcript.
Lexicographic permutation rank three is B,A,C; its gap advances rank one to four in the anchor suit.

limitations: Finite references supplement the general written proofs and stated input bounds.
